intro.text:
Two inlets feed one curved pipe: a 1 m/s main stream and a 3 m/s side jet.

Colours show the flow speed.

outro.text:
Two inlets, one pipe: the fast jet never fully blends in before the exit.

OpenFOAM icoFoam · imported Fluent mesh

captions.text: Blue-green is the 1 m/s main stream from the left. Red is the 3 m/s side jet from below.
White lines are streamlines. The fast jet hugs the outer wall of the bend.
Where the two streams meet, the jet wobbles back and forth.
After about 40 seconds the wobble dies out and the flow settles.
The streams flow side by side to the exit, with the fast jet along the outer wall.
